info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Platform Operations Management API
info.description: The Platform Operations Management API provides access to essential IT management functionalities for banking microservices. This API enables users to retrieve operational data related to platform management, serving as a vital resource for IT teams overseeing performance and stability. Typical consumers include operations managers, system administrators, and IT support personnel who need real-time insights into platform functionality and uptime. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and maintain optimal service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve platform operation details for the specified resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about platform operations associated with a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It delivers vital operational data necessary for IT management tasks.
